title: Custom themes
body:
This pull request introduces significant improvements to the SpectAcoular application framework, focusing on extensibility for custom apps, enhanced theming and UI consistency, and better camera control handling. The changes streamline the process for building custom applications, provide a unified approach to light/dark themes, improve camera widget reliability, and add several usability enhancements.

**Key highlights:**
- New documentation and API for building custom applications by subclassing `BaseApp`.
- Major refactor of `BaseApp` to support a unified theme switch, customizable headers, and easier extension.
- Improved camera component with more robust callback handling and widget labeling.
- Enhanced measurement app UI, including better color handling and section titles.
- Dependency and packaging updates to support new theming and visualization features.

### Custom Application Support and Documentation
- Added a new user guide section, `custom_apps.rst`, demonstrating how to build custom apps by subclassing `BaseApp`, and updated the documentation index to reference this guide. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-2ece3a913c7fe9110726fa7694ae591949382827d9378ec1a679a699e3e3a5ceR1-R44) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-76cd044ef3654dca07153017c0628ff55016881d4372abbde410c3c2618142fbR17) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-76cd044ef3654dca07153017c0628ff55016881d4372abbde410c3c2618142fbR37-R40)

### Theming and Base Application Refactor
- Refactored `BaseApp` in `apps/base.py` to provide a shared Bokeh page template, centralized theme switching (light/dark), a consistent header with exit and theme switch buttons, and an extensible layout for custom content. Added support for a validated update interval input and improved application of theme styles throughout the UI. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-1a5dbee65ab9002a7926b1cc540d47d388c6199cb634b3b8f3728d0e88ad97b2L8-R99) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-1a5dbee65ab9002a7926b1cc540d47d388c6199cb634b3b8f3728d0e88ad97b2R111-R121) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-1a5dbee65ab9002a7926b1cc540d47d388c6199cb634b3b8f3728d0e88ad97b2R152-R170)

### Camera Component Improvements
- Enhanced camera widget labels and button types for clarity, introduced a robust callback removal mechanism to avoid duplicate or stale callbacks, and improved handling of camera stream restarts on resolution or mode changes. Added support for updating glyph extents when related controls change. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-1a2003e71c2d83fc6921aeb360a80dbc5a4495b5c99f045595cec2c6e11370c7L87-R90) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-1a2003e71c2d83fc6921aeb360a80dbc5a4495b5c99f045595cec2c6e11370c7L131-R134) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-1a2003e71c2d83fc6921aeb360a80dbc5a4495b5c99f045595cec2c6e11370c7R144) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-1a2003e71c2d83fc6921aeb360a80dbc5a4495b5c99f045595cec2c6e11370c7R178-R195) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-1a2003e71c2d83fc6921aeb360a80dbc5a4495b5c99f045595cec2c6e11370c7R219-R254) [[6]](diffhunk://#diff-1a2003e71c2d83fc6921aeb360a80dbc5a4495b5c99f045595cec2c6e11370c7R273-R284)

### Measurement App UI and Color Consistency
- Updated `MeasurementApp` to use color constants from the new theming module, improved section title rendering, introduced constants for microphone glyph sizing and beamforming ranges, and replaced the update period selector with the new numeric input from `BaseApp`. Enhanced layout and styling for control panels and tabs. title: FixiFixiSlopiDiSlop
body:
This pull request introduces significant improvements to the handling of phantom audio streams and the measurement app's workflow, focusing on in-memory phantom data generation, streamlined worker management, and enhanced UI controls for streaming and measurement actions. The changes modernize phantom data generation, decouple stream draining from display/record/beamforming actions, and provide a more robust and user-friendly control flow for starting and stopping audio-related processes.

**Phantom Data Generation and Control Improvements:**

* The `PhantomControl` now generates a deterministic, in-memory repeating phantom audio stream using a new `create_phantom_rotation_data` function, removing the dependency on bundled example data files. This also introduces caching for generated data to improve performance. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-0bae09e6e4a592ce7d2f4c3103e0728b494df52281a09569a8c988f98c291797R28-R64) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-0bae09e6e4a592ce7d2f4c3103e0728b494df52281a09569a8c988f98c291797L97-R157)
* The `TimeSamplesPhantom` class has been extended to support endless repetition of data (`repeat` property), and now exposes the number of samples as `-1` for infinite streams. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-4914402f6df7c3ba74150510eaa49374b50032714ebc8ebcf4db64279c29c535R71-R76) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-4914402f6df7c3ba74150510eaa49374b50032714ebc8ebcf4db64279c29c535R87) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-4914402f6df7c3ba74150510eaa49374b50032714ebc8ebcf4db64279c29c535R103-R115)

**Measurement App Workflow Refactor:**

* The measurement app (`MeasurementApp`) now separates stream draining from display, recording, and beamforming actions by introducing a dedicated `StreamDrain` worker. This enables independent toggling of actions and ensures the stream is always drained when active. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-96116fe900b6c87c360e619bf50d90e24bc5fd31536425bbb03cda678a225132L51-R62) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-96116fe900b6c87c360e619bf50d90e24bc5fd31536425bbb03cda678a225132R85) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-77f5a5a1c0f3a44ad4051bd2e5afc82853ef93621e9a398d05a72e4042fe82f8R31-R38)
* The app replaces the previous workflow management with explicit worker threads for each action (stream, display, record, beamform), improving clarity and reliability in starting/stopping each function. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-96116fe900b6c87c360e619bf50d90e24bc5fd31536425bbb03cda678a225132L51-R62) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-96116fe900b6c87c360e619bf50d90e24bc5fd31536425bbb03cda678a225132L346-R532)

**User Interface Enhancements:**

* Adds a prominent "Stream" toggle button, visually separating stream activation from measurement actions. Display, record, and beamforming toggles are now grouped and only enabled when streaming is active, preventing invalid state transitions. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-96116fe900b6c87c360e619bf50d90e24bc5fd31536425bbb03cda678a225132R40-R41) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-96116fe900b6c87c360e619bf50d90e24bc5fd31536425bbb03cda678a225132L203-R251) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-96116fe900b6c87c360e619bf50d90e24bc5fd31536425bbb03cda678a225132R363)
* Updates widget layouts and disables/enables controls more intuitively based on the current workflow state. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-96116fe900b6c87c360e619bf50d90e24bc5fd31536425bbb03cda678a225132L203-R251) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-96116fe900b6c87c360e619bf50d90e24bc5fd31536425bbb03cda678a225132L346-R532)

**General Codebase Improvements:**

* Refactors and simplifies error handling and control enabling/disabling logic, and introduces utility methods for consistent toggle state management. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-1a5dbee65ab9002a7926b1cc540d47d388c6199cb634b3b8f3728d0e88ad97b2L77-L79) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-96116fe900b6c87c360e619bf50d90e24bc5fd31536425bbb03cda678a225132L346-R532)
* Updates imports and docstrings for clarity and to reflect new functionality. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-0bae09e6e4a592ce7d2f4c3103e0728b494df52281a09569a8c988f98c291797R8-R15) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-77f5a5a1c0f3a44ad4051bd2e5afc82853ef93621e9a398d05a72e4042fe82f8L1-R10) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-4914402f6df7c3ba74150510eaa49374b50032714ebc8ebcf4db64279c29c535R36)

These changes collectively make the measurement application more robust, modular, and user-friendly, and lay the groundwork for future extensions to in-memory and real-time streaming workflows.

title: BUG: Incorrect calibration in `measurement_app`
body:
There are several issues with the implementation of the calibration routine in the measurement app:

1. `to_pa` uses `/10` instead of `/20` so the level-to-pressure conversion is wrong for SPL amplitude
2. `magnitude` is misleading naming because it is actually a calibration level in dB
3. averaging is done on levels instead of linear magnitudes / pressure domain

title: CI coverage job fails when `pyproject.toml` changes without a matching `uv.lock` update
body:
In #48, the coverage job is not failing in coverage generation itself. It fails earlier during the `uv` environment setup step.

#48 should not/cannot be merged before fixing this.

### What happens
This repo declares a private SSH dependency source:

```toml
[tool.uv.sources]
tapy = { git = "ssh://git@git.tu-berlin.de/akustik/tapy.git", branch = "dev" }
```

As long as `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock` remain consistent, CI on `master` appears to work (see #50). But if `pyproject.toml` is changed without regenerating `uv.lock`, `uv` is forced into dependency re-resolution/update work during CI setup. In that resolution path it touches the global `tapy` source, and the GitHub Actions runner then fails because it cannot access the private SSH repository.

Typical error:

```text
Failed to download and build `tapy @ git+ssh://git@git.tu-berlin.de/akustik/tapy.git@dev`
Host key verification failed.
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```

body:
## Overview

This PR upgrades **spectacoular** from `v26.03` to `v26.04` with a major refactoring of the app architecture:
apps are moved into the package, renamed to consistent snake_case with `_app` suffix, and registered as proper
entry points. Additional improvements include camera enhancements, package structure cleanup, and CI updates.

---

## App Renaming

All apps have been renamed from their legacy PascalCase/abbreviated names to consistent `snake_case_app` identifiers.

| Old name (directory / entry point) | New name (directory / entry point) |
|---|---|
| `FreqBeamformingExample` / `bf_example` | `bf_example_app` |
| `TimeSamplesExample` / `timesamples_app` | `data_viewer_app` |
| `SLM` / `slm_app` | `level_meter_app` |
| `Measurement_App` / `msm_app` | `measurement_app` |
| `MicGeomExample` / `micgeom_app` | `micgeom_app` *(path only changed)* |
| `RotatingExample` / `rotating_app` | `rotating_example_app` |
| — | `result_explorer` *(removed)* |

---

## Changes by Category

### 📦 Package Structure

- Apps moved from top-level `apps/` directory into the package at `src/spectacoular/apps/`
- Each app is now a proper Python sub-package with its own `__init__.py` exposing a `main()` entry point
- Source layout migrated to `src/` layout (`spectacoular/` → `src/spectacoular/`)
- Build target updated: `hatch.build.targets.wheel` now uses `packages = ["src/spectacoular"]`
- `hatch.version.path` updated to `src/spectacoular/version.py`

### 🔧 Entry Points (`pyproject.toml`)

Old `[project.scripts]`:
```
slm_app        → spectacoular.apps.slm_app:main
result_explorer → spectacoular.apps.result_explorer:main
micgeom_app    → spectacoular.apps.micgeom_app:main
timesamples_app → spectacoular.apps.timesamples_app:main
msm_app        → spectacoular.apps.msm_app:main
rotating_app   → spectacoular.apps.rotating_app:main
```

New `[project.scripts]`:
```
micgeom_app          → spectacoular.apps.micgeom_app:main
msm_app              → spectacoular.apps.measurement_app:main
bf_example_app       → spectacoular.apps.bf_example_app:main
rotating_example_app → spectacoular.apps.rotating_example_app:main
level_meter_app      → spectacoular.apps.level_meter_app:main
data_viewer_app      → spectacoular.apps.data_viewer_app:main
```

### 🐍 Python Version Support

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `requires-python` | `>=3.10,<3.14` | `>=3.11,<3.15` |
| Dropped | — | Python 3.10 |
| Added | — | Python 3.14 |

### 📷 Camera / Measurement App Improvements (from `#36`, `#43`, `#45`)

- Support for custom video resolution and auto-restart on camera disconnect
- Added horizontal flip button to video feed
- Prevent error when measurement data is missing
- Added calibration test mode
- Fixed sounddevice integration (`fix_sd`, PR #45)
- Removed unconditional import that could cause import errors

### 🧹 Cleanup

- Removed legacy shell scripts (`start_apollo_TA181.sh`, `start_phantom.sh`, `start_sounddevice.sh`, `start_tornado.sh`, `start_typhoon.sh`)
- Removed `__author__`, `__date__`, and other module-level metadata variables from `version.py`
- Removed `acoular_future/tprocess.py` (`MaskedChannels` no longer needed)
- Removed `create_layout.py` helper script
- Removed `Acoular_logo` symlink and duplicate assets from app template directories
- Removed per-app `templates/` and `theme.yaml` files (replaced by package-level theming)

### 📚 Documentation & CI

- Added README badges
- Updated `docs/apps/measurementapp.rst` references
- Added `docs/news/index.rst` entry for v26.04
- Removed obsolete CI workflows: `cron_jobs.yml`, `regtest_inspect.yml`
- Updated `orga-ci.yml`

### 📦 Dependency Lockfile

- `uv.lock` regenerated (significant churn from dependency resolver updates)

---

## Files Changed

|---|---|---|---|

| CI workflows | — | `orga-ci.yml` | `cron_jobs.yml`, `regtest_inspect.yml` |
| `uv.lock` | — | ✅ | — |
| Tests (`tests/test_apps.py`) | — | ✅ | — |

Release notes are here: https://docs.bokeh.org/en/latest/docs/releases.html
Migration guide here: https://github.com/bokeh/bokeh/wiki/Migration-Guides

I had a problem running the demos with the import of 'widgetbox' and 'Panel', because they weren't available in bokeh 3.0.0.
Since then, I downgraded to bokeh 2.4.3 and now ~I'm testing~ I can confirm that the interfaces start in the browser.
